recipe_note: Official VisionViTPose DINOv2 256px architecture. Legacy adaptation preserves the shared WL12000/stride1200/eval12000 independent-validation queue without repeat; the official ViT-S YAML uses WL7790/stride780/eval7790/repeat2. The standalone vit_large YAML is unpublished at the pinned revision; this is an explicitly S-derived recipe with the Table 8 backbone/batch/150-epoch budget.
